GameplayEvent Rules3 sections
Event Rules

◆ During the event period, event items can be obtained through limited-time events and at the event store.

◆ Use event items during the event to obtain random rewards and event points.

◆ Event points can be exchanged for items in the event points store.

Event Rankings

◆ Rankings are based on the amount of points players accumulate during the event.

◆ Final ranking results will be caculated 5 minutes after the event ends. Rank rewards will be sent after calculation.

Other

◆ After the event ends, unused items will be converted to event points.

◆ Unspent event points will be retained for the next time an event of the same type takes place.
